interval.primary: 95% intervals resample patients within each true condition (the fixed 10-per-condition mix is the estimand); the condition bootstrap, which also varies the mix, is printed as the superpopulation sensitivity. Counts of 0 or n carry exact Clopper-Pearson bounds.

single-flag.label: Always escalate, one fixed flag on the most common target: I21 (Possible NSTEMI / STEMI; names a target on 12 of 90 SERIOUS cases)

dxa.label: DXA reader (tier-1 DXA p >= 10%, not a red herring)

target-named.label: Always escalate, naming a target on every SERIOUS case (the current 0)
